FIA_data_release: Live USDA FIA DataMart ZIPs matched exactly by archived SHA; source first retrieved 2026-10-19
inference: source-linked descriptive; no survey-weighted forest population estimates, no causal niche claims
primary_growth_metric: annualized change in natural log diameter for prior-live/current-live links
secondary_status_metric: observed current dead / (current live + current dead) among prior-live linked trees (not true annual mortality)
selection: All taxa meeting >=30 same-species forward-year links in EACH of all three frozen states; selected without DIA/status data
size_standardization: Only bins 1-<5,5-<10,10-<20,20+ inches with >=30 live-live pairs per state, shared pooled observed weights
